objective: Pure rules for v0.5: LoginRules (weekly and monthly tracks, month arithmetic, idempotent tick and claim), the GardenConfig data (LOGIN slots, the weekly and monthly eggs, six exclusive species, Index 108, login-only cosmetics, ICON_SET), GardenProgress wrappers and the `login` save field, the MetaRules `grant` condition, and every spec that pins them.
acceptance_criteria: src/shared/LoginRules.luau exports every 3.11 signature; monthOf matches the spec's date table; tick counts a day once and resets each track on its own rollover; claim pays in order, scaled with floor and cap, adds the egg to prizeEggs once, grants a cosmetic once then coins only, is idempotent on a re-applied copy, and refuses after a rollover (tests/LoginRules.spec.luau)

GardenConfig: 26 species in X3.4 order, EGGS 10 with weekly and monthly after aurora (no price, no stock, level 1, exclusive set, top and meter), INDEX_SIZE 108, five grant = login cosmetics, LOGIN with 7 ascending slots per track and the eggs at week slot 5 and month slot 4, isPrizeable, ICON_SET of 16 (tests/GardenConfig.spec.luau); no sold egg names an exclusive species

MetaRules.isUnlocked treats grant like price and sanitizeMeta keeps granted ids in owned; buyCosmetic refuses a grant cosmetic; Relay and Night specs unchanged (tests/MetaRules.spec.luau)

GardenRules.buyEgg refuses weekly and monthly; canPlantPrize allows them at level 1 with a free bed (tests/GardenRules.spec.luau); HatchRules seeded rolls unchanged and the two eggs roll weather mutations and charms (tests/HatchRules.spec.luau)
lune run tests/run passes; Purity.spec covers LoginRules; stylua and selene clean
